text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I'm heading to the stadium
with a friend
to watch a baseball game
when I see...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Just keep following, just keep
following...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Er, Rice?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You've been following me for the last
little
while... If there's something I can
help you with,
please do let me know.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's nothing like that. I'm kind of
trying to
study you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I want to run like you so I can win my
next race!
That's why I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I see... So you were observing me in
hopes of
discovering the secret to my
strength?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
While I am flattered that you would
choose me as
someone to emulate, I'm
running late for the
game, so I really
must go—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A game?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...!
I suppose there's nothing for it. Come
with me,
Rice!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: BRING 'EM HOME, YU-TA-KA!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eep! Y-yeah! Bring them home...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Rice, I can barely hear you! You need to
use your
diaphragm!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Th-there's a lot more to baseball than I
thought. I
didn't realize there would be
so much shouting...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Indeed! And for the record, my attending a baseball game today was mere coincidence... I just coincidentally wanted to learn something new, and coincidentally, there was a baseball game today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It would seem the desire to cheer for athletes who are giving their all with your all is universal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I imagine the people who cheer us on in
our races
feel precisely the same thing...
Truly, that's the
impression I was left
with.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Watching those players shook me to my
very soul.
I wish to engender the same
feeling in the people
who come to watch
me race.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I want to win for the people cheering me
on too.
No matter how hard it can be, or
how much I want
to cry sometimes...
Knowing I've got their support
makes it
all worth it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
With them by my side, I can become
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. There you have it. Looks like you

succeeded in finding one of the secrets
to my
strength. ♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the lesson! And, um,
watching the
game with you... was fun
too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Really? Then I'm glad. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'd appreciate it if you'd keep our
sojourn
today between us. I shudder to
think what
people, especially Gold Ship,
would say if—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: S-sure thing! You can't just go around telling anybody the secret to your strength!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But I'm really grateful you let me in on
yours.
Thanks to you, I'm sure victory
will be mine in the
next race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling I didn't quite convey my
intent
clearly... But I am happy I could
help.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And if... if you ever feel like watching
another
game, I'd gladly accompany
you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Conversely, if I feel the need to follow
up my
studies with another trip to the
stadium... I may
call on you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah! That sounds great!
